title: Highly Skilled Professional (Type 2)
docsTitle: Required Documents for Highly Skilled Professional II
tips:
・HSP (ii) visa is for **experienced highly skilled professionals** who have held HSP (i) status for 3+ years

・Provides **maximum flexibility** with unlimited activities, no points requirement renewal, and extended residence periods

・Allows **diverse work activities** across multiple fields without restriction to original category

・Must maintain **minimum 70 points** throughout HSP (i) period before transition

・Check transition requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

> 📊 **Use the Points Calculator Tool**
> 
> 🔗 **[Highly Skilled Professional Points Calculator](/en/tools/hsp-points)** → Verify your points history
> 
> ⚠️ **Important:** Must prove 3+ years HSP (i) experience and maintained 70+ points.
